gaps.required_work: Build a git adapter that derives changed-file status, numstat, changed symbols, and exact source/ref provenance from a real worktree or commit range, with adversarial tests for renames, deletes, binary files, and malformed refs.

Build a provenance-preserving adapter that converts issue/PR requirements and repository constraints into the intent contract, retaining source links and refusing ambiguous material requirements instead of guessing.
Add an incremental watcher/event interface that re-evaluates drift after each patch delta and emits deterministic before/after receipts usable by an agent loop.
Execute required tests from the repository environment, bind exact command/exit/output digests to the observed patch, and prevent caller-supplied test status from satisfying the intent contract.
Create an independently labeled aligned/misaligned patch corpus and evaluation harness measuring false allows, false refuses, drift-detection timing, and review usefulness.
